caption: The drawing features two separate rectangular panels. The panel on the left is a square with a light background and features a symmetrical floral motif. The center of this panel displays a circular element from which four stylized leaves or petals radiate outward, each leaf occupying a quadrant of the square. Behind the leaves, the background is shaded in a darker gray tone, which contrasts with the lighter color of the leaves and circular center. The panel on the right is rectangular with a light background filled with small stippled dots. It contains an ornamental design composed of flowing, curved, leafy shapes arranged symmetrically around a central axis, with swirling leaf tips curling inward and outward. The lines within this panel are black, clearly defining the shapes against the speckled background. Under the panels, there is text that reads "USS Hartford" under the left panel and "Sideboard Rosette and Panel Detail" under the right panel. The overall composition of the drawing is clean, with each ornamental design contained within its own rectangular border and set against a plain, light-colored page.
title: Sideboard
